shared_tail.surface: أبي عبيدة بن محمد بن عمار

notes: Two «ح»-style branches meet below: the names written once after the last branch are the shared tail (rule 3).
«- المعنى -» and «- قال مسدد من الأنصار ثم اتفقا -» are editor's glosses; «زاد مسدد فسمع قوله» is an addition by a teacher already in group 2: left out.
«قال زيد بن ثابت يغفر الله لرافع» : Zayd speaks and his account is the saying, so he is the last link (rule 6); the Prophet is the end.
